The '''Great Czerka Datacrash''' was a famous event involving [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] that was perpetrated by the freelance [[Spy/Legends|spy]] known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] sometime prior to the [[conquest of Makeb]]<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3638 BBY]].<ref name="Time" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Great Czerka Datacrash was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Shroud in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], a [[2013]] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
